h1: Custom 3 oz Barware for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 3 oz barware for your next event or promotion. Perfect for tastings, samples, and branded giveaways.
introHtml: Custom 3 oz barware is ideal for serving samples, shooters, or tasting portions at events, trade shows, or in-store promotions. These small-format glasses and cups make your brand part of the experience without overwhelming guests. Whether you choose shot glasses, tasting cups, or mini tumblers, 3 oz barware keeps portions controlled while maximizing visibility for your logo. Decorate with screen printing, etching, or full-color wraps to match your brand colors.
heroAltText: Custom 3 oz barware shot glasses with company logo for promotional events and tastings.
